story-context.principle: Clear separation between preview and production; configurable test threshold; readiness visibility before publish.

in-scope.item: Preview vs production flag on submissions; filter/separate by mode
Test threshold: optional per company, adjustable, stored in config/DB
Test runs: preview submission or "Record test run"; counted and audited (who, when)
Block publish when threshold enabled and not met; clear UI message
Readiness badge in Builder or Dashboard
Form status: draft / pending / published / unpublished (minimal for this story)

done-criteria.dc: Submissions store preview vs production flag; backend/API support filtering
Test threshold configurable per company (enabled/disabled, value); stored in DB/config
Test runs counted and audited (who, when)
Publish blocked when threshold enabled and not met; clear UI message
Readiness badge visible in Builder or Dashboard
UAT guide executed and marked PASSED

story-5.4-integration.note: Story 5.4 delivered shared resolver parity. Preview and production use same resolution; this story adds mode separation and test gating.
